instruction: Use the opened OpenStudio application and its CLI/API automation interface to organize /home/user/Desktop/init.osm and save the updated model as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm. Do not directly create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process OSM text outside the OpenStudio environment. The current model is a two-story community library retrofit with a simple flat roof, continuous south shading, and a quieter north reading facade. The first floor faces the street and contains a lobby, stacks, cafe area, and support space; the second floor contains reading, maker, and small classroom spaces. Without changing floor heights, the roof, or the main horizontal order of the south facade, complete an integrated energy model covering space uses, loads, ventilation, shading, second-floor daylight controls, and cafe water use. Deliver only the updated OpenStudio model file; object handles, serialization order, and automatically generated metadata may vary naturally.
